item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:30 HKT 31/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Saola will move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea and towards the coast of eastern Guangdong today and tomorrow, edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary gradually. It will be windy with frequent heavy squally showers and storm surge over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow and over the weekend. Seas will be high with swells. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coast of southern China early next week. Besides, Haikui will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow.

Date/Month: 31/08 (Thursday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, force 6 later. Occasionally force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Sunny periods and isolated showers. Hot and dry during the day. There will be swells.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low

Date/Month: 01/09 (Friday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be more frequent later. Seas will be high with swells.
